focus: causal stateful threshold or gain neuron
direction: Invent a causal dynamic threshold/gain neuron using cumsum, causal conv, or parallel scan-like tensor operations. No Python loop over tokens.

Invent a neuron/block-local primitive that keeps the sample efficiency of squared activations but improves gradient stability, dead-channel behavior, or bounded curvature.
